title: David Petraeus resigns as CIA Director
trigger: The FBI discovered an extramarital affair between CIA Director David Petraeus and his biographer Paula Broadwell during an investigation into harassing emails, leading Petraeus to resign.

timeline.event: FBI agents interview Petraeus about harassing emails sent by Paula Broadwell to another woman
Petraeus meets with President Obama and offers his resignation
Obama accepts Petraeus's resignation; Jim Clapper named acting CIA Director
Petraeus pleads guilty to a misdemeanor charge of mishandling classified information

outcome.summary: Petraeus resigned as CIA Director in November 2012 after the discovery of his affair with biographer Paula Broadwell. He pleaded guilty to a misdemeanor charge of mishandling classified information and received two years' probation and a $100,000 fine. Jim Clapper served as acting Director until John Brennan was confirmed.

claims.text: The FBI discovered Petraeus's extramarital affair with Paula Broadwell during an unrelated investigation
Petraeus met with President Obama on November 6, 2012 and offered his resignation
Obama accepted Petraeus's resignation on November 9, 2012
Petraeus pleaded guilty to a misdemeanor charge of mishandling classified information in 2013
